We share food often between us because normally only one of us has lunch or we’re agreeing to split or whatever. Then , one of my others friends sat down, asked to try one. M proceeded to plead with me and apologise and ask ‘nicely’. But I told them they’re only saying that becuase I told her to, and didn’t let her have one. Me finishing them off. Apparently I’m the asshole for excluding her, but I was just upset that she lunged straight for my food before even acknowledging me. Everyone else I shared with asked. I guess me refusing her as she attempted to ask again is borderline assholery. Reddit , AITA?
